name: What factors determine the cost of professional drywall finishing?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of professional drywall finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on the room size, ceiling height, condition of existing framing, and the required finish level. Basic repairs or taping for standard textured walls fall on the lower end, whereas high ceilings, curved walls, or full Level 5 smooth finishes increase labor hours. Project scope matters as well: small patch repairs often carry minimum trip charges, while finishing an entire basement or room addition reduces the cost per square foot because mudding and drying can be staggered across rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total square footage, ceiling height, framing straightness, required finish level, and whether the job is an isolated repair or a full remodel.
